why: Stops noticing that Exit Developer Mode left a developer parameter in the address. The RULE is pinned elsewhere (`developerExitSearch` has its own describe block in src/game/dev-config.test.ts); what this judges is the URL a browser really landed on, which is the only thing that can catch the rule being right and `exitDeveloperMode`'s wiring to `location.assign` being wrong. Without it the journey would report a clean exit from a page still in developer mode.
killedBy: exitContractFailures: judging where Exit landed FAILS when a developer parameter survives the exit
exitContractFailures: judging where Exit landed reports every breach at once rather than stopping at the first
